card.name: Separators in brain-injury symptom lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', 'in' and bullets inside lists of symptoms of intracranial bleeding, cerebral edema or head trauma. It marks the spot where the next symptom or outcome is expected.

modes.label: List joiners
modes.description: Comma or 'or' between symptoms of intracranial hemorrhage or cerebral edema.
modes.example: Symptoms of intracranial hemorrhage may include headache, nausea<<,>> vomiting, vision changes, or altered mental

modes.label: Outcome link
modes.description: Linking word right before a severe outcome of intracranial bleeding.
modes.example: Intracranial bleeding resulting<< in>> death has been reported.

modes.label: List openers
modes.description: Bullet or colon that starts a list of neurological signs.
modes.example: with signs/symptoms such as:<< •>> diffuse cerebral edema on neuroimaging

card.writes: It leans toward words like dead and alive, so it adds death or consciousness-related outcome terms.
card.plain: It fires on the small punctuation and linking words in lists of serious brain bleeding or swelling symptoms.
